newsitem.title: GERMANY: LTU installs TCAS warning system in all aircraft.
newsitem.headline: LTU installs TCAS warning system in all aircraft.

text.p: German holiday airline LTU International Airways said it had installed electronic collision warning systems on its entire fleet.
All 28 aircraft now have the traffic collision avoidance system (TCAS) of U.S. manufacturer Allied Signal Inc, a company statement said.
LTU has a fleet ranging from 209-seat Boeing 757-200 aircraft to 408-seat McDonnell Douglas MD-11 aircraft.
LTU is the first airline in Germany with TCAS on all aircraft, it added.
The system is already compulsory for all aircraft in the U.S. with more than 30 seats but will not become obligatory in Europe until 2000.
